content:
[V] med | right panel header | Debug-style string "Priority: none" is shown raw in the ticket subtitle line, leaking internal enum values into UI text.
[L] med | conversation detail card | The Assignee combo box and its dropdown arrow are clipped/abutted against the "Assign" button with almost no gap, making the control look cut off.
[S] low | conversation detail card | Field labels ("Assignee", "Priority", "State", "Tags") are baseline-misaligned with their control rows, sitting slightly higher than the widgets they name.
[S] med | conversation detail card | Vertical rhythm between field rows is uneven — extra-large gaps after "Assignee" and "Priority" rows compared to tighter spacing between State/Tags/Snooze.
[H] med | right panel header | "Active", "Copilot" and the refresh icon all carry similar visual weight at the top-right, with no clear primary/secondary distinction among header actions.
[L] low | search row, left panel | The "#" filter button is an awkward narrow fixed-width box whose label is a bare symbol, floating between the search field and Apply with inconsistent sizing.
[C] med | right of the Conversation card | A large dead zone of empty gray background stretches to the right of the detail card and across the whole area between the card and the date divider, unmanaged and unused.
[C] med | right panel, date divider row | The "2026-02-16" timeline divider floats in whitespace with no message content above or below it, orphaned as a standalone element.
[C] low | right panel, reply composer | The message textarea is mostly empty dark space below the placeholder with no supporting content, creating a large low-density region.
[H] low | left conversation list | Sender name, date, subject, assignee and status badge all use similar small text sizes, so nothing distinguishes the primary subject line from metadata at a glance.
[S] low | left list first card | The selected conversation card's top edge nearly touches the search/filter row, cramped compared to the generous spacing between subsequent cards.
[S] med | Filters/Reset row | "Filters" and "Reset" labels are unevenly spaced from each other and from the right-aligned "Sync now" button, breaking the row's alignment rhythm.
[S] low | conversation detail card | The Status segmented control and Priority segmented control have identical styles though they edit different fields, giving equal prominence to unrelated attributes.
[C] low | left sidebar | The narrow "Views" label column and the filter list are squeezed against the conversation list with no visual separation, making the two panels read as one cramped region.
[L] low | right panel composer header | The "Reply/Note" tab group sits far left while "Saved Replies"/"AI Draft" sit far right, leaving a stretched empty middle in the composer header row.

TOTAL 15
